name: Beaam
description:
Beaam keeps watch over the services behind your product and brings forward only what needs attention. Use the connector to inspect current health, review monitoring coverage, investigate incidents and likely causes, manage watchlists and alert rules, and test notification delivery. Calls are scoped to the connected Beaam organization. Read-only and destructive actions are annotated independently so Claude can ask for confirmation when appropriate.

Beaam supports Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, Supabase, Neon, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Stripe, Polar, Resend, DigitalOcean, Hostinger, HTTP endpoints, and MCP servers. It can also connect providers, schedule maintenance, route notifications, and help apply a monitoring plan generated from a project.

Every tool uses the same capability layer as the Beaam web app and API, under row-level security scoped to the signed-in organization. Billing, subscription changes, API-key issuance, and organization administration are deliberately not exposed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Beaam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Beaam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.beaam.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Beaam MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beaam lists 81 MCP tools, including acknowledge_incident, acknowledge_welcome, add_incident_note, apply_monitoring_plan, begin_aws_connect, begin_oauth_connect, cancel_maintenance_window, check_aws_registration, check_coverage, check_oauth_connect, connect_aws, and connect_cloudflare.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Beaam?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Beaam in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Beaam requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Beaam is developed by Teqnyk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
